checks.name: normal completion preserves every historical report field and statistic
cancel returns invalid partial evidence with no FPS claim and no terminal snapshot
repeated cancel resolves once and leaves no pending timeout
cancel before first frame is explicit, bounded, and serializable
a stale cancelled timeout cannot finish or cancel a subsequent run
completion followed by cancel cannot resolve twice or mutate a settled report
concurrent start remains rejected without replacing its owner or timer
historical duration clamp is preserved and cancellation clears long timers

limits: Tests the actual benchmark source and preserved baseline with deterministic clock/timer/snapshot seams.
No WebGL calls, context restoration, browser timing, renderer FPS or GPU-time accuracy is verified here.
Cancellation keeps partial raw statistics as invalid diagnostic evidence; averageFps and terminal snapshot are null.
